movement_profile.footwork: Includes pointe work for the ballerina
movement_profile.partnering: Includes lifts, steadying during turns, and providing support for balances.

signature_moves.description: Ballerina on pointe while partner walks around her.
signature_moves.name: Promenade

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Varies by section: slow for adagio, fast for coda.

reference_recordings.title: Swan Lake (Black Swan Pas de deux)
The Nutcracker (Sugar Plum Fairy Pas de deux)

music_profile.sound_description: Orchestral music structured to match the five-part dance, moving from slow, lyrical adagio melodies to fast, high-energy climactic codas.

basic_steps: Promenade: ballerina balances on pointe while the partner turns her.
Pirouettes: partner stabilizes and provides impulse for turns.
teaching.level_notes: Requires advanced muscular strengthening and technique, particularly for the ballerina on pointe.
